test_strategy: Adopt a hybrid testing strategy combining automated API testing (using Jest + Supertest), data validation in Databricks notebooks (PyTest and SQL assertions), and performance benchmarking using Spark metrics. For ETL and streaming validation, integrate with Airflow DAG test suites using pytest-airflow. Governance and security tests will use Databricks REST API mock verification and permission validation in Unity Catalog. All tests will run in CI/CD pipelines with dedicated staging environment mirroring AWS Databricks Runtime 13.3 LTS.

test_cases.title: Verify Hive to Delta table conversion retains schema and backward compatibility
test_cases.description: Ensure schema consistency and query compatibility after converting a Hive table to Delta format using Databricks conversion utility.
preconditions: Hive table with known schema exists
steps: Run conversion utility ('CONVERT TO DELTA') on target Hive table
Execute SELECT queries using legacy syntax via Tableau/Looker connections
Compare schema definition pre- and post-migration
test_cases.expected_result: Table converted successfully; schema unchanged; dashboards connect without errors and queries execute normally.

test_cases.title: Validate ACID transactions maintain data integrity with concurrent writes
test_cases.description: Simulate concurrent ETL jobs writing to the same Delta table to confirm transactional consistency.
preconditions: Configured Delta table with transaction log enabled
steps: Launch two concurrent batch jobs updating records in Delta table
Monitor transaction logs for conflict resolution
Read final data snapshot and check for duplicate or corrupted records
test_cases.expected_result: Delta transaction log maintains atomic consistency with no corrupted or duplicated records across jobs.

test_cases.title: Validate time travel functionality with 30-day retention
test_cases.description: Test Delta Lake time travel queries for historical snapshots up to 30 days and verify purging beyond retention threshold.
preconditions: Delta table with historical versions available
steps: Execute SELECT query AS OF timestamp within past 30 days
Execute SELECT query AS OF timestamp older than 30 days
Attempt rollback of a Delta table version older than retention
test_cases.expected_result: Data from valid timestamps is retrieved correctly; older versions beyond 30 days are purged.

test_cases.title: Test query performance improvement with Z-ordering and compaction
test_cases.description: Benchmark query execution times before and after applying Z-order indexing and compaction on top 20 queries.
steps: Run benchmark suite against unoptimized tables
Apply Z-order optimization on designated columns
Run same queries on optimized tables
Compare execution times and storage utilization
test_cases.expected_result: Query time reduced by >=50%; storage reduced by ~30%.

test_cases.title: Verify Unity Catalog registration and access control
test_cases.description: Ensure migrated Delta tables are registered correctly in Unity Catalog with proper access permissions and lineage tracking.
steps: Run API endpoint '/api/catalog/register'
Query registered tables via BI tools using non-admin and admin users
Inspect lineage tracking logs for ETL data flow records
test_cases.expected_result: Tables registered successfully; access enforced per user role; lineage captured accurately.

test_cases.title: Validate unified batch and streaming data consistency
test_cases.description: Test that real-time Kafka streams and batch ETL jobs operate on same Delta tables without data loss or query interruption.
steps: Start Kafka producer sending data to Delta target
Run batch job to update same table concurrently
Query the table during ingestion and validate completeness
test_cases.expected_result: Streaming and batch operations continue smoothly with consistent and real-time queryable data.

test_cases.title: Evaluate training workshop effectiveness for Delta Lake adoption
test_cases.description: Assess training outcomes by verifying completion and performance of knowledge assessments post workshops.
steps: Conduct two workshops with the engineering team
Collect feedback and confidence survey from attendees
Execute knowledge assessment and calculate average scores
test_cases.expected_result: 90% of engineers report confidence improvement; average test scores exceed 80%.

test_cases.title: API Endpoint Validation - Migration Start and Status
test_cases.description: Validate REST API endpoints for starting Delta migration and checking job status via Express controllers.
steps: Send POST request to /api/migration/start with valid tables list
Verify 200 response with job_id
Send GET request to /api/migration/status/{job_id}
Verify job status contains correct progress and state
test_cases.expected_result: API responds successfully with proper job start and status data.

test_cases.title: Negative Test - Invalid API inputs trigger proper error handling
test_cases.description: Confirm API rejects invalid requests and returns 400/500 errors appropriately.
steps: Send POST request to /api/migration/start with empty table list
Send POST request to /api/optimization/zorder with missing columns
Simulate Databricks API failure in /api/catalog/register
test_cases.expected_result: System returns correct error codes (400 or 500) and descriptive error messages.

test_data_requirements: Schema definitions for existing 500 Hive tables
Sample ETL job configurations simulating concurrent writes
Historical data versions for time travel validation
Performance baseline metrics for top 20 queries
Unity Catalog user roles and permissions dataset
Streaming Kafka topics with realistic data payloads
automation_approach: Use Jest and Supertest frameworks for Node.js API unit and integration tests. Data migration and schema validation automated via Databricks notebooks tested using PyTest SQL assertions. Airflow DAG tests run via pytest-airflow plugin for orchestration integrity. Performance benchmarking automated using Spark job metrics and stored in test dashboards. CI/CD pipeline integrates GitHub Actions for test execution and reporting, ensuring fail-fast on migration or governance regressions.
coverage_goals: 100% test coverage for REST API controllers and services; 90% coverage for data migration logic; performance tests covering top 20 queries; full validation of governance, access, and lineage; and time travel retention validation for all migrated tables.
